name: ChatGPT Bridge
description: Connects ChatGPT Voice to Lumina through durable local MCP jobs and retains the legacy marked-order browser relay.

cdpUrl.description: CDP endpoint of the managed browser holding the ChatGPT tab.

sessionKey.description: OpenClaw chat session that receives the relayed orders.

agentId.description: Agent that handles the relayed orders. Defaults to the session's own agent.

mcpSessionKey.description: Dedicated OpenClaw session used by the local ChatGPT MCP server.

mcpAgentId.description: Agent that executes orders received through the local ChatGPT MCP server.

marker.description: Prefix ChatGPT must emit on its own line for a reply to be treated as an order.

urlPattern.description: Substring identifying the ChatGPT tab among open pages.

userTurnWindowMs.description: An order is only relayed if you spoke to ChatGPT within this window. Blocks orders a page injected into ChatGPT on its own.

minIntervalMs.description: Minimum spacing between two relayed orders.

denyPatterns.description: An order matching any of these is never relayed. Case-insensitive regular expressions.

enabled.label: Relay ChatGPT orders
enabled.help: Watch the ChatGPT tab and forward orders it marks with the configured prefix into the OpenClaw chat.

sessionKey.label: Target session
sessionKey.help: Session key that receives the orders, e.g. agent:main:main for the main dashboard chat.

mcpSessionKey.label: ChatGPT Voice session
mcpSessionKey.help: Dedicated session that receives orders from the local MCP server.
